# ChannelPitch <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ChannelPitch:Void channel:Int32, pitch:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `channel` | In | Int32 | required | A channel handle from [PlaySound](PlaySound). |
| `pitch` | In | Int32 | required | The new playback frequency, for example 8000 to 44100. Values of 0 or less are ignored. |

## Description

Changes the speed and the pitch of a channel that is playing or paused. The value is a sampling frequency in hertz: take the frequency of the sound as the middle value, so a 22050 Hz sound that is set to 44100 plays twice as fast and an octave higher.

## Differences

* Changing the pitch also changes the speed, because the sound is resampled. There is no way to keep the speed.
* A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the channel was never given out. A channel that is over is fine everywhere, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).

## Examples

```blitzbasic
; MakeBeep writes beep.wav, see the LoadSound example for the code.
Local snd = LoadSound("beep.wav")
LoopSound snd
Local ch = PlaySound(snd)
For f = 11025 To 44100 Step 1000
	ChannelPitch ch, f
	Delay 40
Next
StopChannel ch
```
